plain_text:
$$ Welcome $$
 to another special issue of
WHO's stories from the field on
universal health coverage (UHC)
semantic_text: $$ Welcome $$ to another special issue of WHO's stories from the field on universal health coverage (UHC)

plain_text:
These stories document how countries
are reshaping their health systems amid
one of the most devastating pandemics
in history.
semantic_text: These stories document how countries are reshaping their health systems amid one of the most devastating pandemics in history.

plain_text:
COVID-19 pandemic is relentlessly
magnifying the consequences of
neglecting to address the political,
social and economic inequities that
divide the world.
semantic_text: COVID-19 pandemic is relentlessly magnifying the consequences of neglecting to address the political, social and economic inequities that divide the world.

plain_text:
Health for all - and health systems that
protect everyone regardless of race,
religion, gender or wealth - is a both
a human right and a prerequisite to
achieving sustainable socio-economic
development.
semantic_text: Health for all - and health systems that protect everyone regardless of race, religion, gender or wealth - is a both a human right and a prerequisite to achieving sustainable socio-economic development.

plain_text:
Renewed and stronger political will is
needed now, more than ever, to place
health equity high on the global agenda
and achieve universal health coverage.
Building a fairer, healthier world where
everyone can get the health care they
need, when they need it, without falling
into financial hardship, relies on greater
investments in primary health care (PHC).
semantic_text: Renewed and stronger political will is needed now, more than ever, to place health equity high on the global agenda and achieve universal health coverage. Building a fairer, healthier world where everyone can get the health care they need, when they need it, without falling into financial hardship, relies on greater investments in primary health care (PHC).

plain_text:
People-centred PHC, with equity in
service delivery, ultimately paves the way
for a fairer, healthier world for all. PHC is
essential to an equitable recovery from
the COVID-19 pandemic and to ensure
that countries are better prepared to
prevent and respond to future health
emergencies. It is also the best way for
countries to achieve UHC and the health-
related Sustainable Development Goals.
semantic_text: People-centred PHC, with equity in service delivery, ultimately paves the way for a fairer, healthier world for all. PHC is essential to an equitable recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic and to ensure that countries are better prepared to prevent and respond to future health emergencies. It is also the best way for countries to achieve UHC and the health-related Sustainable Development Goals.

plain_text:
The UHC Partnership, one of WHO's
largest initiatives for international
cooperation for UHC, is providing vital
and timely support to enable countries to
take advantage of the opportunity to
emerge stronger from the pandemic. It is
working to ensure that the investments
made throughout the COVID-19 response
will result in health system reforms that
improve both health security and
progress towards UHC.
semantic_text: The UHC Partnership, one of WHO's largest initiatives for international cooperation for UHC, is providing vital and timely support to enable countries to take advantage of the opportunity to emerge stronger from the pandemic. It is working to ensure that the investments made throughout the COVID-19 response will result in health system reforms that improve both health security and progress towards UHC.

plain_text:
The stories in this publication
demonstrate the depth and breadth
of work that WHO, through the UHC
Partnership, is undertaking to achieve
health for all. They document the results
of collaboration with governments,
communities and our partners.
